title: 川辺で、ひとやすみ。
tagline: 清流で、のんびり一釣行。

controls.summary: 川面をクリック／タップまたは矢印で狙い、固定位置で投げる。餌＋浮き／ルアーを選択、ルアーは1回ずつ引く、本アタリで合わせ、弱い引きで巻く
controls.evidence: current game source / manifest / native UI; exact key bindings remain in game instructions

difficulty.label: 標準
difficulty.basis: design assessment; human difficulty feedback pending

mainMechanics: 4地点の投げ先と2釣法を選び、待ち／誘引・合わせ・巻く／緩めるで5分の釣果を積む。釣果は横の水槽で泳ぐ
description: 4地点の投げ先と2釣法を選び、待ち／誘引・合わせ・巻く／緩めるで5分の釣果を積む。釣果は横の水槽で泳ぐ
failureModes: 早合わせ・遅合わせ・過剰なテンションでその魚を逃す。釣行は継続する

design.thumbnailDescription: 川辺で、ひとやすみ。の実プレイ画面。既存の美麗清流背景、独自2D麦わら帽子少年6ポーズ、7魚種とImageGen写真調水槽、静かな水面と判読可能なUI
design.majorVisuals: 既存の美麗清流背景、独自2D麦わら帽子少年6ポーズ、7魚種とImageGen写真調水槽、静かな水面と判読可能なUI
design.directionNotes: Keep each game identity; code and assets determine collision and input. Thumbnail is captured from gameplay, not a fictional composition.
design.referenceImageUse: User countryside cartoon boy reference is broad illustrative taste only; new original straw-hat teal/cream boy, no face/clothes/emblem/net/basket copied. Actual ImageGen originals/provenance in assets/game032/revision01.
design.uiPolicy: Responsive native input; portal shows four primary tag badges; explanation/practice remain optional.

telemetryCoverage: Sparse standard fishing events and existing lifecycle; practice excluded from production. External Analytics and record transport remain OFF for032 until its existing production Worker registration is independently verified. Anonymous fishing_summary only; no raw player IDs.
humanEvaluation: pending; do not infer fun or real-device comfort from synthetic QA

currentManifest.coreMechanic: choose water target while stationary; bait float waiting or click-retrieve lure; hook and alternate reel with release; catches swim in photographic generated aquarium
currentManifest.skill: water target and method selection, lure rhythm, hook timing, readable fish tension
currentManifest.score: total fishing score in one completed five-minute standard outing
currentManifest.failure: early/late hooks and excessive tension lose that fish; outing continues
currentManifest.practice: untimed independent outing; no local BEST, ranking candidate or production RUN
currentManifest.save: existing validated local-only standard:r1 score unchanged; aquarium shows current outing catches and is not persistent

inputs.keyboard: arrows aim; Space/Enter press-release cast, click retrieve lure, hook, hold reel; Escape pause
inputs.touch: tap/drag water target; bait/lure selector and phase-labelled single action; pointercancel cleanup

currentManifest.prototypeStatus: trial; technical QA distinct from author enjoyment
currentManifest.telemetry: existing lifecycle + specific_game_events sparse fishing observations; external OFF until actual Worker registration
currentManifest.rights: original gameplay, generated natural art with provenance; no third-party fishing game assets/code
